# ⚔️ 534's Better Netherite

534's Better Netherite is a PvP-friendly resource pack that improves the look of Netherite tools while keeping the classic Minecraft style.

The pack makes Netherite tools cleaner, sharper, and easier to see during combat, while still fitting perfectly into vanilla Minecraft.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

✨ Features

Improved Netherite tools

Shorter tools for better visibility in PvP

Clean textures designed for PvP

Vanilla-friendly style

Lightweight pack

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

🎮 Compatibility

Game: Minecraft Java Edition

Versions: 1.16.x – 1.21.x

Designed for: PvP gameplay

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

📦 Installation

Download the .zip file

Open Minecraft

Go to Options → Resource Packs

Click Open Pack Folder

Place the .zip file in the folder and enable it
